card.line: Myra was an important city in Lycia, on the southwest coast of Asia Minor, where Paul changed ships on his way to Rome.

moments.title: Paul arrives at Myra
moments.text: After sailing across the open sea off Cilicia and Pamphylia, Paul and those with him came to Myra in Lycia.

moments.title: A ship bound for Italy
moments.text: At Myra the centurion found an Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy and put Paul and the others on board.
